title: Interactive: both solvers, both cases
caption: Time slider, run selector, membrane clipping, slices and particles (three.js).
simulations: One seed per solver and case, recorded every 0.25 s into results bundles (sims/render_3d.py): conversion to 2 s, exchange to 5 s. Native particles are placed at their nodes from VCell's per-node counts; its membrane is VCell's smooth surface.
interpretation: Explore either solver at any recorded time.
